summary: Tested hardening sprint: 9 P0 items (indexes, pool, rate limits, /auth/refresh, sanitizer, scheduler status, sitemap/robots, stripe breaker, Sentry). Backend pytest: 9/10 passed. Fixed one frontend bug (SchedulerStatusCard double /api prefix) and updated static robots.txt. One unresolved public-URL-only robots.txt issue requires static asset rebuild/CDN purge.

minor.issue: Served by Express (static /app/frontend/public/robots.txt), not FastAPI dynamic route. Originally missing 'Disallow: /api/'. I updated /app/frontend/public/robots.txt to include it, but preview CDN/Express may still serve old copy until frontend rebuild + Cloudflare purge.

ui_bugs.issue: axios.get built URL `${API_BASE}/api/admin/scheduler/status` but API_BASE already equals `${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api`, producing `/api/api/admin/scheduler/status` (404). Silent catch swallowed the error so card always showed '0 jobs'. FIXED by T1 (removed duplicate /api).

issues: Non-blocking React warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' in EnhancedUserManager (pre-existing, unrelated to sprint)
Non-blocking warning: invalid DOM prop 'fetchpriority' (should be 'fetchPriority') appears in multiple places

Alternatively, configure ingress to route /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml to backend (current ingress only routes /sitemap.xml dynamically; /robots.txt goes to Express static).

critical_code_review_comments: SchedulerStatusCard.js had a silent catch block (line 34–36) that hid the 404 — recommend surfacing at least a console.warn so future regressions are visible.

Dynamic /robots.txt route in backend is effectively unreachable through the public ingress because a static file at /app/frontend/public/robots.txt shadows it. Either remove the static file or reroute /robots.txt to backend.
API_BASE constant already includes `/api`; several components (confirm via grep) may still be constructing `${API_BASE}/api/...`. Main agent should audit usages.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after T1 fix (SchedulerStatusCard now renders 30 jobs, home page loads without blocking errors)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter180 validated hardening sprint. All backend endpoints verified: /api/health 200, /sitemap.xml has 13 <url> entries, login returns access_token+refresh_token, /api/auth/refresh rotates (new pair) and invalidates old (401 on reuse), login rate limit 429 with bilingual message_en/message_fr, bid POST rate limit hits 429 within 11 tries, /api/admin/scheduler/status returns scheduler_running=true with 30 jobs each having name/last_run/last_status/last_duration_ms/next_run fields, sanitizer rejects $where (400), sanitizer allows normal search (200). Only failing test is /robots.txt public URL (frontend static shadows backend). T1 applied two minor fixes: (1) SchedulerStatusCard double-/api URL; (2) added 'Disallow: /api/' to static robots.txt.
rca_of_the_issue: Scheduler card showing 0 jobs: API_BASE in /app/frontend/src/config.js is defined as `${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api`. SchedulerStatusCard.js then did `${API_BASE}/api/admin/scheduler/status`, producing a double-prefix that returned 404. The axios call used a silent catch, so the failure was invisible in the UI (card showed 'No scheduled jobs reported yet.'). Fix: change to `${API_BASE}/admin/scheduler/status`. Robots.txt issue: Kubernetes ingress routes /robots.txt to the React frontend (port 3000), where Express serves /app/frontend/public/robots.txt (static), which did not contain 'Disallow: /api/'. Backend's dynamic /robots.txt is never reached publicly. Mitigation: update the static file (done) or change ingress routing.
